PRIMITIVE · qeva:1:object@1

Object

An object is whatever a chosen mathematical discourse permits us to refer to as one thing.

editorialfoundations · ontology

PLAIN

The idea

An object is whatever a chosen mathematical discourse permits us to refer to as one thing.

EXACT

The compact statement

Object is a role in a framework, not a universal substance. A framework supplies a domain U of admissible referents and rules for forming or recognizing them.

EXAMPLE

A number, function, proof, graph, or group may each be an object in a suitable framework.

BOUNDARY / CAVEAT

Different foundations encode the same informal object differently.

ASSUMPTIONS

  • The declared preformal metalanguage context is fixed.

PROVENANCE

Original QEVA orientation record. It is a compact map entry, not a substitute for a textbook or primary source.
